article.headline: Scores from last Night: Locklear scores twice as Pass Christian ends West Harrison’s unbeaten start
article.html:
Addison Locklear scored twice as Pass Christian beat West Harrison 3–1 in girls soccer Wednesday, October 28, keeping the Pirates perfect and handing the Hurricanes their first loss. The schools split their soccer results, with West Harrison winning the boys match 1–0.

Pass Christian girls stay perfect

Locklear’s two goals helped Pass Christian win on the road, while goalkeeper Ally Funderburk made four saves and allowed one goal. The Pirates finished 2–0, and West Harrison stood at 2–1–1.

The Pirates followed their 4–0 opening win over Pascagoula on Monday with another victory, this time against a West Harrison team that had yet to lose. The matchup was featured in our Wednesday Games To Watch preview.

West Harrison boys earn their first win

West Harrison’s boys won 1–0 over Pass Christian, turning a one-goal decision in their favor a night after a 3–2 loss to Hancock. The shutout gave the Hurricanes their first win and a 1–1–1 record. Pass Christian finished 0–2.

East Rankin rebounds in girls basketball

East Rankin Academy won 61–6 at Canton Academy in a girls varsity tournament game. The Patriots evened their record at 1–1, while Canton Academy fell to 0–2.

East Rankin had opened with a 63–26 loss to Pillow Academy on Monday. Wednesday’s result gave the Patriots their first win. That opening-night basketball coverage is also in our October 26 roundup.
